$doc: out/factory/reconcile.json — the cross-document reconciliations behind FACTORY-PACK.html and FACTORY-QUESTIONS.html. Generated by tools/reconcile.py. Each entry names every count that exists for one quantity, what each counts, and which one to act on.

robot_hat_outline.subject: Pollen's published Apache-2.0 Robot HAT — the board outline
robot_hat_outline.measured_how: this script parsed reference/pollen-elec-rpi-robot-hat/elec_RPI_Robot_HAT.kicad_pcb and took the bounding box of every top-level gr_line / gr_arc on the Edge.Cuts layer. 8 shapes, 20 points.

agreeing.note: written by tools/extract_hat_pcb.py from the same kicad_pcb; agrees with this measurement

contradicted.claim: Board measured off the kicad_pcb: 65.000 x 48.500 mm
contradicted.why: Dwgs.User — KiCad's drawing/annotation layer — has bbox 65.0000 x 48.6000 mm on this board, because its dimension witness lines hang 17.6999 mm below the copper. A bounding box taken over the DRAWING layer instead of Edge.Cuts reproduces the 48.5 figure to 0.1000 mm. That is the most likely origin of the wrong number; it is not the board.
contradicted.owned_by: the WF-UNKNOWNS lane (out/open/ is theirs to write); this lane cannot correct that file and states the contradiction instead

contradicted.claim: the published outline is 65.0 x 48.5 x 1.0 mm
contradicted.verdict: CORRECTED in this pass — it now carries the measured 30.9001 mm and cites this file

robot_hat_outline.what_this_changes: The question we put to the factory (Q5.4) said adopting Pollen's published board means 're-modelling the motor support to a 65.0 x 48.5 mm board'. It does not. The published board is 65.0 x 30.9001 mm against our reconstruction's 65.0 x 30.0 mm — a difference of 0.9001 mm on one axis, not 18.5 mm. The decision is therefore much cheaper than the question implied, and Q5.4 has been rewritten on the measurement.

still_open.question: Does a 30.9001 mm board fit the HAT pocket in microduck-motor-support?
still_open.why: no pocket dimension has ever been measured: ce-parts/microduck-motor-support carries no interface record for the HAT seat, and the only board we have modelled there is the 30.025 mm simulation mesh.
still_open.what_settles_it: measure the HAT pocket in the motor-support solid against a 30.9001 mm board — desk work on geometry already in the repository; it is parcel B-3a in WORK-BREAKDOWN.html

fasteners.subject: How many fasteners are in one Microduck
fasteners.verdict: CANNOT DETERMINE — no count in this repository is a screw count taken off a real robot

counts.what_en: HOLE FEATURES in the community hole analysis
counts.what_zh: 社区孔位分析统计的孔特征数
counts.breakdown_en: Ø2.2 clearance x77, Ø4.4 counterbore x28, Ø1.6 tap x20, Ø2.7/2.8 x20
counts.breakdown_zh: Ø2.2 间隙孔 x77、Ø4.4 沉孔 x28、Ø1.6 攻丝底孔 x20、Ø2.7/2.8 孔 x20
counts.counts_what_en: HOLES, not screws. A counterbored clearance hole is ONE fastener location that appears in this list twice — once as a Ø2.2 clearance and once as a Ø4.4 counterbore — so the 145 is an UPPER BOUND on hole features and cannot be read as a screw count.
counts.counts_what_zh: 统计的是孔而非螺钉。一个带沉孔的过孔在此表中出现两次（Ø2.2 间隙孔一次、Ø4.4 沉孔一次），因此 145 是孔特征数的上限，不能当作螺钉数量。
counts.may_a_buyer_order_against_it: NO — it counts holes, and it double-counts counterbored ones

counts.what_en: FASTENING FEATURES measured off our own geometry
counts.what_zh: 从我方几何体实测得到的紧固特征数
counts.breakdown_en: across 54 parts that carry an interface record; implied M2 x38, M2.5 x7
counts.breakdown_zh: 覆盖 54 个带接口记录的零件
counts.counts_what_en: features a part MEASURED off its own solid and recorded. It is lower than the community hole count because only 54 of the 47 meshes have been rebuilt parametrically and can be measured at all.
counts.counts_what_zh: 零件从自身实体上实测并记录的特征。低于社区孔数，因为仅部分零件已参数化重建、可供测量。
counts.may_a_buyer_order_against_it: NO — it is a census of what we can measure, not of what the robot has

counts.what_en: SCREWS actually placed in the assembly, each through a connection
counts.what_zh: 实际装入装配体的螺钉数（均经连接件定位）
counts.source: out/fasteners/placed.json counts (tools/place_fasteners.py); BOM: 45 rows, 7 fastener rows
counts.counts_what_en: real solids in the model, with a length and a connection each. This is the only one of the four that says WHICH screw goes WHERE, and it is incomplete: it covers the runs the fastener lane has reached so far.
counts.counts_what_zh: 模型中的真实实体，每颗都有长度与连接方式。四者中唯一说明“哪颗螺钉装在哪里”的数据，但尚不完整。
counts.may_a_buyer_order_against_it: NOT YET — it is the per-hole schedule being built, and it is incomplete

counts.what_en: PIECES on the buy list, per robot
counts.what_zh: 采购清单上的每台件数
counts.breakdown_en: B18a M2 x 6 socket head cap screw x80; B18b M2 socket head cap screws x185; B18c M2 heat-set threaded inserts x60
counts.breakdown_zh: B18a x80 件; B18b x185 件; B18c x60 件
counts.counts_what_en: PIECES to buy, and it counts things the hole census does not: nuts, five different screw lengths, M2.5, and heat-set inserts. Its own basis field says COMMUNITY-DERIVED from hole-fitting on the 47 meshes, NOT a Pollen BOM.
counts.counts_what_zh: 采购件数，包含孔数统计中没有的项：螺母、五种螺钉长度、M2.5 以及热熔螺母。其依据字段自述为：由 47 个网格的孔位拟合推得，并非 Pollen 的 BOM。
counts.may_a_buyer_order_against_it: YES, as an upper bound with spares — it is the only piece count that exists

fasteners.why_they_differ_en: They count four different things: hole features (with counterbores double-counted), measurable interface features on the parts we have rebuilt, screws placed in the model so far, and pieces on a buy list that also includes nuts and inserts. None of them is wrong; quoting any one of them as 'the number of fasteners' is.
fasteners.why_they_differ_zh: 四者统计的对象不同：孔特征（沉孔被重复计数）、已重建零件上可测的接口特征、目前已装入模型的螺钉、以及包含螺母与热熔螺母的采购件数。四者都不错，把其中任何一个当成“紧固件总数”才是错的。
fasteners.what_a_buyer_orders_against_en: Order against the buy list — B18a 80 + B18b 185 screws and nuts, B18c 60 heat-set inserts = 325 pieces per robot — and treat it as an UPPER BOUND WITH SPARES, not a bill of materials. Its basis is our own hole-fitting on Pollen's meshes, not a Pollen BOM, and it has never been checked against a real unit.
fasteners.what_a_buyer_orders_against_zh: 按采购清单下单（B18a + B18b 螺钉与螺母、B18c 热熔螺母，合计每台 325 件），并视其为含余量的上限，而非正式物料清单。其依据是我方在 Pollen 网格上的孔位拟合，并非 Pollen 的 BOM，且从未与实物核对。

spread_at_1000_robots.note: the spread between the smallest and largest count, times 1000 robots — which is why the pack states all four instead of one

fasteners.what_closes_it: Two things, in this order. (1) Finish the per-hole schedule: every hole in the model gets its screw, its length and its connection, so the placed count becomes a real bill. That is agent work and it is IN FLIGHT (WF-FASTENERS). (2) Count the screws in a real unit during the teardown (parcel M-2) and compare. Until (2), every count here is derived from Pollen's simulation meshes and none has been checked against hardware.

unknowns.subject: How many CANNOT DETERMINE items are open

curated_harvest.what_it_is_en: a HAND-CURATED list: the distinct open questions someone judged worth working, each written with what would settle it. It is the work queue, not a census.
curated_harvest.what_it_is_zh: 人工整理的清单：被判定值得推进的独立未定问题，每条都写明如何定案。它是工作队列，不是普查结果。

repository_census.what_it_is_en: every string in the repository that reads CANNOT DETERMINE, deduplicated by subject. It is an UPPER BOUND: one item republished across generated documents is counted once per distinct wording, so the same question appears several times. Its own note says as much.
repository_census.what_it_is_zh: 仓库中所有写有 CANNOT DETERMINE 的文本，按主题去重后的结果。这是上限：同一项在多份生成文档中以不同措辞重复出现时会被多次计入，该文件自身也如此说明。

unknowns.verdict: BOTH ARE TRUE OF DIFFERENT QUESTIONS
unknowns.reconciliation_en: 139 is the size of the work queue. 5012 is the size of the haystack. The pack quotes the 139, and it must say which it is quoting, because an engineer who greps this repository for CANNOT DETERMINE will find 6182 occurrences and conclude the pack understated by a factor of 36.
unknowns.reconciliation_zh: 139 是工作队列的规模；5012 是待筛查文本的规模。交付包引用的是前者，并且必须写明这一点——否则工程师在仓库中检索 CANNOT DETERMINE 会得到 6182 处，从而认为交付包把问题少报了约 36 倍。
unknowns.the_real_defect: Not the count. It is that only 514 of 5012 distinct subjects state what would settle them, so 4498 have no closure route written down at all. A CANNOT DETERMINE with no named closer is the one kind this project treats as a defect.

eol_gates.subject: Is the end-of-line gate list complete?

exemptions.why: The LSM6DSV16X sits behind an unidentified MCU on the imu_to_dxl board and is on no host bus, so its chip self-test cannot be run on an assembled robot at all. SN-05 is an incoming-inspection gate for the bare board, not an end-of-line gate for the unit. Putting it on the ship list would put a box on the sheet that no line operator can ever tick.
exemptions.where_it_runs_instead: an imu_to_dxl board on a bench fixture with SPI or I2C brought out, before the board is fitted

exemptions.why: On today's published software the expected verdict is CANNOT DETERMINE: no NFC service appears in the release and no reader IC has been identified. A checklist row that is answered CANNOT DETERMINE on every good unit trains people to tick it anyway.
exemptions.where_it_runs_instead: a teardown that names the reader IC, or a Pollen release that ships an NFC service

eol_gates.arithmetic: 44 gated tests = 42 on the ship list + 2 exempt
eol_gates.what_was_wrong_en: spec/test-plan.json's eol_note claims the list is COMPLETE by construction because every gated test is either on the ship list or 'on the exemption list below it with a reason'. The exemption list exists in the data (eol_exempt, 2 rows) and FACTORY-PACK never rendered it, so the completeness claim could not be checked by a reader — and the note itself was clipped at 400 of its 725 characters, cutting the sentence off mid-clause. Both are fixed: the note is printed whole and the exemptions are a table.

glossary.what_en: A flat-bottomed enlargement at the mouth of a hole so a cap-screw head sits below the surface. On this robot: Ø4.4 over a Ø2.2 clearance hole, for an M2 socket head.
glossary.what_zh: 孔口处的平底扩孔，使内六角螺钉头沉入表面以下。本机为 Ø2.2 过孔上方的 Ø4.4 沉孔，配 M2 内六角圆柱头螺钉。

glossary.what_en: A conical enlargement for a flat-head screw. Not used on this robot; listed so it is not confused with a counterbore.
glossary.what_zh: 供沉头螺钉使用的锥形扩孔。本机未使用，列出以免与沉孔混淆。

glossary.what_en: A hole the screw passes THROUGH without engaging thread. Ø2.2 for M2 here (ISO medium fit).
glossary.what_zh: 螺钉穿过而不与之啮合的孔。本机 M2 用 Ø2.2（ISO 中等配合）。

glossary.what_en: A hole the screw threads INTO. Ø1.6 is the TAP-DRILL size for an M2 thread; a finished M2 tapped hole is not Ø1.6.
glossary.what_zh: 螺钉旋入的孔。Ø1.6 是 M2 螺纹的底孔直径；攻好丝的 M2 螺孔并非 Ø1.6。

glossary.what_en: The hole passes entirely through the part. The opposite is a blind hole.
glossary.what_zh: 孔贯穿整个零件。与之相对的是盲孔。

glossary.term_zh: 热熔螺母 / 热压螺母
glossary.what_en: A knurled brass nut pressed into printed plastic with a heated tool, giving a metal thread in a plastic part.
glossary.what_zh: 用加热工具压入打印塑料件的滚花黄铜螺母，使塑料件获得金属螺纹。

glossary.what_en: The shaft is larger than the bore and is pressed in. Used for the bearing seats.
glossary.what_zh: 轴径大于孔径，需压入装配。本机用于轴承座。

glossary.what_en: Material yield strength divided by the peak simulated stress. Every SF in this project is SIMULATED, never measured.
glossary.what_zh: 材料屈服强度除以仿真峰值应力。本项目所有安全系数均为仿真值，非实测。

glossary.what_en: Review of a part against the process that will actually make it.
glossary.what_zh: 针对实际制造工艺对零件进行的评审。

glossary.what_en: The PCB layout checked against the fabricator's own minimum track, space and drill rules.
glossary.what_zh: 按 PCB 厂自有的最小线宽、间距与钻孔规则对布线进行检查。

glossary.what_en: The smallest quantity a supplier will sell.
glossary.what_zh: 供应商可接受的最小销售数量。

glossary.what_en: Full dimensional and functional inspection of the first units off a new process.
glossary.what_zh: 对新工艺下线的首批整机进行的全尺寸与功能检验。

glossary.what_en: The shortest distance between two surfaces found by casting rays through the solid. At an edge or a fillet run-out this goes to nearly zero and IS NOT a printable wall.
glossary.what_zh: 对实体投射射线所测得的两面之间最短距离。在棱边或圆角收尾处该值趋近于零，不是可打印壁厚。
